notes:
FieldStitch 1.5.1 - simpler start:
- Opens on a Projects page: New project, your recent projects with previews, Open project folder, Open a GeoTIFF.
- New project window: choose the flight's folder (or individual photos), check or change the project name and where it's saved, then Create project.
- The processing options open by themselves once the photos are loaded, with any photos that will be skipped listed at the top.
- Inside a project, the Photos panel only adds more photos to that same project, so different flights don't get mixed.
- A labeled Projects button at the top, and a pencil next to the project name to rename it.
